name: Lahontan Reservoir
quote: Lahontan Reservoir placed under HAB Watch Advisory after visual assessments indicated possible harmful algae bloom. Water tests being conducted by Nevada DEP.

quote: A dog died while playing in the Virgin River over the weekend; officials warning public about dangers of HABs. Cyanobacteria hazardous to animals and sometimes people.

name: Lake Lawrence
quote: Lab results from Lake Lawrence May 12, 2026 detected Microcystin at 45.9 µg/L, above state recreation guideline of 8.0 µg/L. Microcystins are a liver toxin and possible human carcinogen.

name: S. California Pacific Coast (Malibu→SD)
quote: Domoic acid event began Wed Feb 19 with a sea lion call. By Friday 8 affected sea lions, 2 dead. 100 calls/day across West Coast Marine Mammal Stranding Network. More than 200 animals killed in Santa Barbara County since February.

name: Contra Loma Reservoir

quote: CCHAB Network meeting minutes from Apr 8, 2026 show Caution advisory at H.V. Eastman Lake in Central Valley region. Annual HAB events common at this site.

name: Cayuga Lake (near Harris Park)
quote: First bloom of 2026 identified Apr 23 in village of Cayuga, northern end of the lake. Volunteer spotted bloom south of Harris Park. Analysts confirmed abundant Microcystis. EARLIEST bloom on record since 2018.

name: Lake Granbury
quote: Fish kill occurred throughout Lake Granbury Feb 8-10, 2026; most dead fish identified as Threadfin Shad. Water samples Feb 10 showed varying P. parvum toxicity across the lake; Mallard Point sample moderately toxic to fish.

name: Beal Park Pond
quote: As of Feb 5, 2026, water sample from Beal Park Pond in Midland had moderate density of P. parvum cells, classified as non-toxic to fish.

name: C.J. Kelly Park Pond
quote: C.J. Kelly Park Pond had high density of P. parvum cells but classified non-toxic to fish. TPWD postponed trout stocking until golden algae bloom subsides.

name: Lake Colorado City
quote: Water samples from Lake Colorado City State Park Feb 5 and Mar 2, 2026 had low density of P. parvum cells, classified non-toxic to fish.

name: King Lake

name: Lake Afton

quote: As of May 1, 2026, warnings remain for King Lake and Lake Afton; SE pond at Frontenac City Lake in Crawford County lifted from watch in April.

Residents advised not to drink, swim, wade, or contact waters with a visible bloom, and to keep pets and livestock away.
